expansion_log.notes: Story 0 created with 58 nonce lemmas (25 nouns, 15 verbs, 12 adjectives, 6 adverbs). All concepts null — meanings to be discovered through future expansion.
First expansion. Brolm discovered as a vast, mutable expanse — a terrain-medium that contains structures but itself transforms.

Sulvek discovered as a verb of emergence/origination. Not movement (melvir) but the transition from non-existence to existence. Takes 'from X' source complement. High reuse rate (96%) — appropriate for a verb-focused story that illustrates the action through existing concepts.
First depth-2 story. Plendrique discovered as a liminal boundary between states of being. 100% reuse — no new words introduced. 9 real English footholds give the reader substantially more traction.
Quelith discovered as the exception to brolm's mutability — the one stable thing in a world of constant change. 100% reuse, 0 new words. DAG links to story_brolm, story_sulvek, story_plendrique.
Grothen discovered as the verb of actualization — bringing latent potential through the plendrique into orniquable being. Climactic verb of Story 0. 100% reuse.

Fenqua discovered as latent, undirected potential — the possibility before the direction. The brolm itself may be a grothened fenqua. Inside quelithen, fenqua is trapped. Depth 2 story with 9 English footholds.

Vrenthane discovered as the manner of unconscious transformation — changing without knowing you're changing. Contrasted with ondrique. The pralune fear it. 7 English footholds including 'blind', 'losing', 'silent'.

Ornique discovered as cognitive apprehension distinct from mere perception (drevith). Two failure modes: morvith (trying and failing) and kethrek (fabricating). The same olvereth can do either. 15 new words introduced.

Pralune discovered as the social class of memory-keepers — the only beings who selmir across jorvunden. The brolm needs them because the brolm cannot ornique itself. 13 new words introduced including selmir/threlven/vossane (collective verbs and gathering).

Savrune discovered at depth 2 as the cognitive gap between drevith and ornique. Every drevith opens its own savrune. Failed crossings leave morvath. The brolm itself may be a savrune. 6 new words introduced.

Morthrene discovered as the collective silence when vrisora reaches its limit. Not absence — vrisora's drilvan into its own savrune. The vossikest pralune teach it is the only true response to the brolm. 6 new words introduced.
